services.title: Loving Care for Every Need of Your Furry Friend
services.text: Every pet has their own habits and personality. Pick the service that suits yours best and start with confidence after a free Meet & Greet.

DOG_WALKING.title: Dog Walking
DOG_WALKING.body: Live GPS route tracking, pee & poop updates, fresh-water breaks and plenty of sniffing adventures.

BOARDING.title: Overnight Boarding
BOARDING.body: While you're away, your pet stays in a sitter's cosy home: cage-free, loved and treated like family all night.

DROP_IN.title: Cat Visits & Play
DROP_IN.body: In the comfort of their own home: food, fresh water, litter cleaning, brushing and a 30-minute laser play session.

DAY_CARE.title: Doggy Day Care
DAY_CARE.body: No more lonely days at home while you work. Social play sessions, yard zoomies and restful nap times.

featured.title: Friendly Pet Lovers in Your Neighbourhood
featured.text: Experienced hands, every one interviewed in person, with police and reference checks completed.

howItWorks.eyebrow: Peace of Mind in 3 Easy Steps
howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.text: Choosing the right sitter for your furry family member has never been this easy, transparent and safe.

step1.title: Browse Local Sitters
step1.body: Filter sitters near you by reviews, experience badges, home photos and calendar availability.

step2.title: Book a Meet & Greet
step2.body: Before you book, meet your sitter at the park or at home for a free <hl>"Meet & Greet"</hl> and see the chemistry for yourself.

step3.title: Relax with Live Updates
step3.body: Adorable photos all day long, GPS walk maps and meal reports let you follow every happy moment as it happens.

howItWorks.pricingNote: Clear prices, no surprises — the sitter's rate plus a flat fee, WagShield vet cover and HST.

wagshield.title: Everything's Covered with WagShield Protection
wagshield.text: To us, every pet is family. That's why every booking on our platform is automatically protected by our highest safety standards.
wagshield.learnMore: Learn More About Our Safety Standards
wagshield.vetText: If something unexpected happens during a booking, we cover up to {amount} in vet treatment costs.
wagshield.lineText: You or your sitter can reach our emergency vet video line with a single tap, any time of day or night.
wagshield.vettingText: Only 2 in 10 applicants are accepted, after ID verification, a home check and a Police Vulnerable Sector Check.
wagshield.paymentsText: Your payment is held securely and only released to the sitter once the stay is complete and you confirm.

testimonials.title: What Pet Parents Are Saying
testimonials.text: Just a few of the thousands of families who enjoy the deep peace of mind that comes from knowing their pet is safe.
